title: Deploy Feeling to Azure after merges to master
outcome: Automatically deploy the existing Feeling application directly to production at delasc.io after each merge to master, with validation and visible deployment results.

in: GitHub Actions automation deploys merges to master directly to the existing production Azure Container App steady-preprod serving delasc.io.
Build and deploy the combined React frontend and Deno API using api/Dockerfile.
Run relevant existing checks before deployment and verify deployed health.
Document required GitHub and Azure authentication, configuration, and recovery steps.
out: Production resource provisioning or secret changes without explicit authority.
A separate staging or nonproduction environment; the owner selected one environment to control costs.

acceptance_criteria.given: A change is merged into master
acceptance_criteria.when: GitHub receives the resulting master update
acceptance_criteria.then: A GitHub Actions run validates and builds the application for Azure deployment.

acceptance_criteria.given: Required validation and the container build succeed
acceptance_criteria.then: The combined frontend and API image for that commit is deployed directly to the existing production Azure Container App steady-preprod serving delasc.io.

acceptance_criteria.given: A required validation or build step fails
acceptance_criteria.then: The run reports failure and does not deploy that build.
The workflow checks application health and readiness and reports failure if either fails.

acceptance_criteria.given: A maintainer inspects a deployment run
acceptance_criteria.then: They can identify the source commit, deployed image, target, and verification outcome without exposed credentials.

constraints: Use Spec Kit for this new feature as requested by the user; existing migration artefacts remain historical context.
Existing image serves frontend and API from one origin.

The owner explicitly selected automatic production deployment on merges to master. This draft records that intended behaviour; it does not authorize unrelated production infrastructure or secret changes.
The former nonproduction Azure environment is now the sole production environment, as confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-10; preprod resource names are historical.
dependencies: Existing production Container App steady-preprod and registry steadypreprodaue001 in resource group rg-steady-preprod-aue.
GitHub Actions identity authorized for registry push and application deployment.
risks: With one environment, a faulty deployment can affect live users directly; validation, health verification, and recovery need design.
Overlapping deployment runs could publish older changes after newer changes; address ordering in design.

approval.reason: Deployment target clarified by the owner on 2026-09-10; explicit approval of the complete brief remains pending.
